settings.subtitle_text: The Refresh Kit is designed to keep your sneakers smelling and looking brand new every day.

settings.question: Are Hague Protect formulas safe for my sneakers?
settings.answer: Yes. Our formulas are pH-balanced and made for premium footwear materials including leather, suede, nubuck, mesh, canvas, and rubber. Always follow the care steps on the product page.

settings.question: Will this change the color or finish?
settings.answer: No. Hague Protect systems are designed to clean and protect without stripping color or damaging finishes when used as directed.

settings.question: What is the best product to clean Jordans?
settings.answer: For Jordans, use the Hague Protect Premium Shoe Cleaner Foam. It is safe on all materials and cleans without altering the colour or texture, keeping Jordans in pristine condition.

settings.question: Can I put my sneakers in the washing machine?
settings.answer: No. Machine washing can warp the shape, loosen the glue and damage leather or suede panels. Clean sneakers by hand with a foam cleaner and soft brush instead.

settings.question: How long does delivery take in India?
settings.answer: Orders placed before 12pm IST on business days usually ship the same day. Delivery across India typically takes 2 to 5 business days depending on your location.

settings.question: What if I need help choosing a kit?
settings.answer: Match the kit to your material, or message us on WhatsApp with a photo of your shoes and we’ll recommend the right care system.
